title: Sunjeya Gharan Vich Ro Ro ke Sughra
body:
Sunjeya Gharan Vich Ro Ro Ke Sughra Ey Vehn Bapa Kardi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyun Bhul Geyo Akbar Veeran
Par Mey Ujri
Tenu Chetay Veer Bara Kardi
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil Darda Shaam Da
Mey Baaldiya Bhujda Deeva
Akbar Dey Naam Da
Meray Saa Lag Javan Veeran
Ali Akbar Nu
Dukhyari Behn Dua Kardi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis Din Da Tu Geyo
Kyun Deyraan Laiyan Aavan Nu Pardesi Veerna
Teri Taang Ney Maar Mukana
Haye Ujri Nu
Dukh Har Velay Tera Kardi
<<DIVIDER>>
Bara Kar Kay Honsala
Teray Oun Dey Vadey Lang Gaye Ney May Vaykaan Teray Raa
Jey Jaandi Akbar Murkey
Tu Nayi Ouna
Tenu Veeran Na Mey Vidaa Kardi
